title: Pick a live voice
body: GPT Live, through your Not Organic account.
line: Keating 4.0 adds GPT Live to the voice model picker. Choose it, and connect your Not Organic account.

title: Your conversation comes with you
body: Recent messages and course context go too.
line: Your recent messages and course context come with you, so the spoken lesson picks up the question you were already working on.

title: Mic, captions, the way back
body: Everything a spoken lesson needs, in one place.
line: The Live surface keeps the microphone, the captions, and the way back to chat, all in one place.

title: Spending you can see
body: A visible ceiling and consent you can revoke.
line: Each session has a visible spending ceiling, and you can revoke live consent in Settings. Ending a call stops the microphone at once.

title: Images and video, elsewhere
body: Other live providers stay one pick away.
line: Need to show an image or video? The other live providers are still one pick away. Talk it through, then get back to the page.
